headline: Frontline Flare‑Ups Intensify Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Day 182 of War 140 finds the map still split between entrenched Warden holdings in the north‑west and Colonial dominance across the southern belt, but the past three hours have sharpened the contest on a half‑dozen fronts. Fisherman’s Row erupted with eight ownership changes in the latest two‑hour window, while Linn Mercy logged six fresh flips and a surge of enlistments on both sides. Weathered Expanse, previously the hottest sector, cooled to three rapid changes yet still records fifty‑four daily flips and accelerating casualties. Stlican Shelf’s frenetic pace eased to zero new two‑hour events, though its twenty‑four‑hour tally remains near fifty with steady loss rates. Godcrofts, quiet in the last edition, shows a burst of six‑hour activity and twenty‑two daily transitions, while Marban Hollow maintains a modest three‑event rhythm. Meanwhile, Callahan’s Passage, Stonecradle and Deadlands report no new two‑hour moves despite heavy casualty traffic, and the deep interior sectors remain static. Enlistments are rising sharply on the most volatile fronts, signalling continued pressure on strategic bases.
